newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare sells McLean clinic in Oregon.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare sells McLean clinic in Oregon.

text.p: PacifiCare Health Systems Inc on Monday said it sold its ownership interest in McLean Clinic of Oregon to MedPartners Inc.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
PacifiCare's decision to sell McLean is part of its ongoing efforts to streamline operations and create greater efficiencies, the company said in a statement.

The clinic consists of 52 full-time employees, including seven primary care physicians with an emphasis on internal medicine. Neither company expects immediate changes in staffing for physicians and administrative jobs.
PacifiCare became owner of McLean in the fall of 1989 as part of its expansion into Oregon.
